protocol.bridge_policy: Score each eligible intercluster edge by its exact forest-cost change; accept only mutually best negative-cost proposals. Each round pairs disjoint clusters.
protocol.correction: Forest-cost controls and bridge variants use minimum-cost tree correction with free parity at each boundary vertex.
protocol.first_pass: Unchanged production UF growth and peeling; its physical correction supplies all correlation weights.
protocol.growth: Every active cluster has per-frontier-edge rate 2**(-ceil(log2(max(1,frontier_edge_count)))).
protocol.hardware: Operation counts and dependency proxies only; event heap is a software simulator, not an FPGA implementation.
protocol.ties: Growth: existing anchored 1e-12 tie batches and ascending edge IDs. Bridges: (cost change,edge ID). Tree DP: parity zero on exact ties.
protocol.truth_access: No truth or MWPM predictions enter native decoding, proposal selection, or stopping.
protocol.weight_precision: Original double-precision log-odds weights; no weight quantization.
